# MouseYSpeed <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Mouse](BlitzBasic-Mouse)

</div>


```blitzbasic
MouseYSpeed:Int32
```

**Returns:** The change of the vertical position since the previous call.

## Description

How far the pointer moved up or down since the last call. See [MouseXSpeed](MouseXSpeed).

## Differences

* The Device argument is a BlitzLLVM extension: the original has no such argument and only knows one mouse.
